dossier.headline: Bank stocks drive the market to a run of record highs
dossier.summary: The Nifty Bank index set three record highs in the week to 20 November, ending Friday at a new peak as banks led a recovery from a gap-down open. Private lenders such as Axis Bank, IndusInd Bank and HDFC Bank led, with state-run banks also outperforming, and reports tied the rally to heavy foreign inflows.
why_it_matters: Banks have been the main engine of the market's November rally
The rally has been tied to record foreign inflows, making it sensitive to any turn in those flows
